# period start

- **CURIE:** [`gmeow:periodStart`](gmeow-periodStart.md)
- **IRI:** <https://blackcatinformatics.ca/gmeow/periodStart>
- **Category:** property
- **Defined by:** [`gmeow:slices/temporal`](../../slices/temporal.md)
- **Box roles:** [RBox role](../boxes/rbox.md) ([What is this?](../../four-boxes/index.md))

The instant at which a named period begins. Functional nature removed because the property chain below makes [`periodStart`](gmeow-periodStart.md) non-simple, and OWL 2 DL forbids non-simple properties in functional axioms ([Principle 8](https://github.com/Blackcat-Informatics/gmeow-ontology/blob/main/CONSTITUTION.md#principle-8)). Closed-world single-valuedness lives in SHACL (NamedPeriodShape).

## Usage Advice

### Use when

- Use to state the start boundary of a [`gmeow:NamedPeriod`](../classes/gmeow-NamedPeriod.md) as a [`gmeow:Instant`](../classes/gmeow-Instant.md), or let it be inferred from a [`gmeow:hasTemporalMeasurement`](gmeow-hasTemporalMeasurement.md) whose [`gmeow:measuredDate`](gmeow-measuredDate.md) is an [`Instant`](../classes/gmeow-Instant.md) via the property chain.

### Avoid when

- Avoid asserting it as functional in OWL (the chain makes it non-simple, P8 — single-valuedness is a SHACL concern) and avoid pointing it at an age measurement ([`gmeow:measuredAge`](gmeow-measuredAge.md) needs solver-layer conversion, P12).

### How to use

- Either assert a [`gmeow:Instant`](../classes/gmeow-Instant.md) directly, or attach a [`gmeow:TemporalMeasurement`](../classes/gmeow-TemporalMeasurement.md) with a [`gmeow:measuredDate`](gmeow-measuredDate.md) and let the propertyChainAxiom derive the start; the NamedPeriodShape enforces a single value at validation time.

### Examples

- ex:holocene [`gmeow:periodStart`](gmeow-periodStart.md) ex:holoceneStartInstant.
